title: vincetoxicum hirundinaria subsp. glaucum
intro: Vincetoxicum hirundinaria subsp. glaucum, commonly known as Pale Swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Pale Swallowwort include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
